Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
this deck's inspiration came from this  newsgroup post of Peter Bakija's HoS deck (stole the card ratios too), combined with new tech from Heirs to the Blood. It's not as strong in direct offense as Giovanni powerbleed since it lacks seduction and govern, but having Auspex provides a lot of flexibility in defense besides bouncing bleeds. Plus the clan cards are fun.

the basic idea is to bring out a few Slaughterhouses, not to deck your prey for Brinksmanship (so much tablehate), but to fuel steady Trochomancy bleeds. You'll need at least 3 of the vampires in play. Babalawo and/or Nicomedes can do amazing things with your hand flow. There's also lots of little tricks that combo with each other, see if you can find them all.

The one problem this deck constantly faces is the vampires running low on blood. This is one example where bloodline clans lacking a hunting ground really hurts. Every time I've played this I got Giants Blood first (Nicomedes helps with that) but in the long term I'm getting grinded down and empty.

played this during the NAC week of nightmares, where it got a table sweep and went to that tournament's final round. others were interested in what's in it, so here's the list.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
> bakija wrote:
> As much as I love Beatrice in general, you have enough forward momentum in this deck that she could easily be replaced by, like, Tauratus and/or Prejudice. Nicomedes is ridiculously good.
>
yeah Beatrice isn't too important and can be swapped out if you feel like it. I tend to leave Babalawo untapped on defense duty so having the extra bleeder helps. I tried Prejudice but every time I used Wider View I went fishing for Sennadurek instead, so I dropped him.

> I can't imagine that Threestar Cab Company couldn't be something more useful. The Rack? The Coven?
>
heh, the one time I played Threestar (the first turn of the tourney finals) everyone asked, "you're seriously playing that crappy card?" but I profited at least 3 or so pool from it. I suppose a Coven + House of Sorrow package might be better overall.

> Shaal Fragment ever pay off?
>
Lots. Having a hand size of 9 or 10 is so fun with Nicomedes. Also helps if I play Lupine Assault; I get to keep more cards than everyone else. Most people seem to completely ignore that they can steal it, and besides I'll steal it back and they'll have more cards in their ash heap. Though one time a !Ventrue Grinder deck stole it and I had too much trouble getting it back.

> Port Authority ever do any good? I'm wondering if there is any synergy here I'm not noticing.
>
It only hurts defense instead of offense. With Nicomedes and/or Babalawo I should be less harmed by it myself. it has some nice synergy with Babalawo's ability, and that Lupine Assault :3
